producer_report.summary: I wrote docs/design/socratic-review.md, a design with no code, and recorded it in three other docs. The document has six fixed question kinds and an answer ladder: facts, then Jev as a typed question with a probability, then at most two user questions ranked by the chance of changing the plan times the cost of being wrong. Questions Athena did not ask are recorded as unasked. Repeated user answers become defaults proposals under the existing three-job rule. A failure traced to an unasked or wrongly answered question raises that question's weight. Each failure gets an origin (plan, execution, verification or environment). Acceptance is honest: only a reply to a prompt counts, and a bare `athena go` is recorded as `unprompted`. A table maps each cited failure to the question that would have caught it. 9gwv, nem8 and PR #59 are marked reported, because I found no record of them. The document also has alternatives, cost per job (athena.toml caps measured, the rest labeled estimates), the reader's 1,800-token budget under D25, and a build order. I added a pointer in the roadmap's RM-4 step, a sentence in the requirements map's A1-3 row, and a CHANGELOG entry. cargo test and cargo fmt --check pass. I did not run clippy: athena.toml skips it for docs-only changes. I also did not scan for the banned words with a tool, only reread the text for them."]

open_issues: Review the design before any build, as the `designed` default requires.
Backtest the claim that each cited failure would have been caught. It needs records/, which I did not have.
Decide between a new `accepted_by` value and a separate field for unprompted acceptance.
Measure the real cost of Jev calls. The per-call price is not measured.
mistakes: The first draft had two markup typos, a stray `**` and a garbled row name. I fixed both.

The 9gwv, nem8 and PR #59 rows rest on the job request alone and are marked reported. The defaults-loop document names nem8's failure class (bundled design and build, C6) without a job id, so the nem8 id is also reported.
I cited defaults-loop section 7.2 for the N = 3 rule from a grep of line 332 and did not read section 7.2 itself.
The 0.85 Jev probability bar and the cost-per-job figures other than the athena.toml caps are estimates, labeled as such in the document.
learnings: records/ is absent, and 9gwv, nem8 and PR #59 appear in no document I could read. 16zf, 8qkc, m1bs and the four reader-budget job ids appear only in docs/design/defaults-loop.md section 3.6. D87 and D88 are in docs/decisions.md.
athena.job/1 accepted_by is currently `user` or `flag` (docs/records.md), so honest acceptance needs a new `unprompted` value.
A test compares the requirements map's counts with the strategy view, so I added no map rows. I appended a sentence to the A1-3 cell instead.
Jev runs only in shadow, and its reply key is still an assumption (crates/athena-core/src/jev.rs header). The design says so and keeps Jev answers inside the two-question cap until Jev is calibrated.
I used git status and git diff only. The sandbox hook blocks git grep.

The BRIEF.md line for the owner-only file list, to cite the guard that K3 would read.
